summary: Iteration 8 (match history + named offline players) validated end-to-end. Backend pytest: 10/10 pass. POST /clubs/{id}/announcements accepts offline_names (trim, empty ignored, capped at 3, names -> offline_players, total_players, slots_left, is_full, club_name). Rétrocompat party_size sans offline_names -> offline_players = liste de strings vides. Join respecte len(players)+len(offline_names) <= 4 (409 quand plein). GET /matches/history renvoie les matchs où l'utilisateur est author OR players contains id, triés desc, avec club_name/players[]/offline_players[]/total_players/is_full; 401 sans token. Frontend: composer offline-name-input + offline-add-btn -> chips offline-name-0/1; post crée bien une carte '3/4 · 1 place libre' avec avatar 'MarcPadel' + pastilles grises 'TESTPaul' + 'TESTSarah' + slot 'Libre'. Historique via my-matches-card ouvre /matches, chaque item a testID history-match-<id>, label 'Joueurs présents', chips 'Toi' (non navigable) + JulieSmash (tappable via history-player-<matchId>-<uid>) + pastilles grises nommées 'Paul'/'Sarah'. Clic sur JulieSmash -> profil joueur avec msg-player-btn 'Envoyer un message' -> ouvre /chat/<userId>. Badge '4/4' vert affiché sur match confirmé, '<n>/4' gris sinon. Aucun red screen. Warnings RN Web 'shadow*' déjà connus (non bloquants).

react_native_issues.issue: React Native Web deprecation warnings persist: 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow). Cosmetic on web preview, non-blocking on native. Reference: multiple StyleSheet.create blocks.

action_items: Optional: migrate remaining shadow* style props to boxShadow to silence RN Web warnings (non-blocking).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:426-430 correctly trims offline_names, ignores empty strings, caps at 3 before persisting.
server.py:407-418 /matches/history uses $or on players/author_id and sorts by created_at desc; reuses serialize_announcement so shape is consistent with list endpoint.
server.py:451-456 join computes cap using len(players)+len(offline_names)|offline_count, honouring both new named list and legacy offline_count docs.

matches.tsx:104-127 renders registered players as tappable chips (history-player-<matchId>-<uid>) — self chip labeled 'Toi' with onPress no-op, others navigate to /player/<id>; offline players rendered as grey non-tappable chips with the first-name.
club/[id].tsx composer exposes offline-name-input + offline-add-btn + offline-name-<i> chips (max 3) and resets state after post — matches spec.
api.ts:53 sends offline_names in POST body; api.ts:54 exposes matchHistory() -> /matches/history.
